name: The Ritz-Carlton, Denver
insider_take: Denver's crown jewel sits at 5,280 feet above sea level, where luxury meets the Mile High City's adventurous spirit in spectacular Rocky Mountain style.
whats_special: This downtown Denver landmark occupies a prime location just blocks from the 16th Street Mall and Union Station. The hotel's Club Level rooms offer breathtaking views of the Front Range mountains, while the property maintains the only AAA Five Diamond spa in Colorado. Fun fact: Denver's unique altitude means champagne bubbles last longer in your glass!
pro_tip: Book a west-facing room above the 20th floor for unobstructed sunset views over the Rockies, and arrive a day early to acclimate to the altitude before hitting the nearby ski slopes.
dont_miss: The hotel's ELWAY'S Downtown restaurant, co-owned by Broncos legend John Elway, and easy access to the Denver Art Museum's unique architecture just a 10-minute walk away. The nearby Rocky Mountain National Park is less than two hours by car for world-class hiking and wildlife viewing.
pros: Prime downtown Denver location with easy access to attractions
Exceptional Ritz-Carlton service and luxury amenities
Elegant accommodations with mountain and city views
cons: Premium luxury pricing reflects high-end positioning
Urban setting may lack resort-style outdoor space
